default_mode: bounded project work with explicit approval gates
approval_required_for: payment, billing, refund, or money-moving actions
messages, uploads, submissions, or other actions sent outside the local project
credential, token, private key, or .env value access
protected_content: personal data not required for the current task
customer or client records not required for the current task
adapter_rules: read project context before changing files
preserve exact task instructions, names, paths, output text, whitespace, casing, and required trailing newlines
validate machine-readable tool plans before execution and repair malformed plans before falling back
keep model-facing context compact for exact-answer or scored evaluation tasks so unrelated metadata does not bury the task
prefer non-invasive preflight and post-check wrappers for exact-answer evaluations instead of injecting process text into the answer prompt
prefer the smallest reversible change that satisfies the work order
turn repeated failures into checks, docs, tests, or backlog items
